section1.title: Failt dys SakuraLands!
content: Cluich rish car-cheeaddyn voish y theihll er fad.
Immee stiagh ayns min-chluichyn ardjey, far-ghooghysyn as ny smoo!

section2.title: Chooilley-Ghaelgagh!
content: T'eh failt er cluicheyderyn voish y theihll er fad.
Ta pobbylaght cur rish cooilley-ghaelg, as bee shiu feddyn car-cheeaddyn rish cluich dy kinjagh.
section2.warning: * Ta cooyrtyn er-eayst lhieggit liorish jastan-lhieggee, as foddee nagh vel ad kiart.

section3.title: Mooarane dy Vini-chluichyn!
content: Jeeagh er y lhiurid voish mini-chluichyn: parkour, skywars, bedwars, faagyl-cooie, as ny smoo.
Ta red elley noa erriu dy kinjagh!

section4.title: Shickyrys!
content: Ta shin kiarail cluich-kiart as shickyrys cluicheyderyn.
Ta shin cur failt er sheshaght-obbree caarjoil dy choadey yn deneydys eu.
